definitions: simple past and past participle of tarnish
A collection of valuable things; accumulated wealth; a stock of money, jewels, etc.

Anything greatly valued.

A term of endearment.

 The female genitals; pudenda.
To consider to be precious; to value highly.
To store or stow in a safe place.

blocks.text: Tarnished is a 1950 American action film directed by Harry Keller, written by John K. Butler and starring Dorothy Patrick, Arthur Franz, Barbra Fuller and Jimmy Lydon. The film was released on February 28, 1950 by Republic Pictures. The screenplay is based on the novel Turn Home, written in 1945 by author Eleanor Mayo.

Treasure is a concentration of wealth — often originating from ancient history — that is considered lost and/or forgotten until rediscovered. Some jurisdictions legally define what constitutes treasure, such as in the British Treasure Act 1996.
